# Bundle: cern-team

A generic CERN team knowledge instance - documentation, meetings, wiki, documents, tickets and code.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | `0.4.0` |
| Extends | nothing |
| Okg versions it supports | `>=0.4.0,<0.5` |

## Packs

- Default: [`docsite`](../packs/docsite.md), [`indico`](../packs/indico.md), [`core-playbooks`](../packs/core-playbooks.md)
- Optional: [`twiki`](../packs/twiki.md), [`cds`](../packs/cds.md), [`jira`](../packs/jira.md), [`git-code`](../packs/git-code.md), [`code-text`](../packs/code-text.md), [`code-symbols`](../packs/code-symbols.md)

Default packs install with the bundle. Add an optional pack with `--with <pack>` at init, or `archi add <pack>` later.

```bash
archi init myteam --bundle cern-team
```

## Chat preset

| Setting | Value |

| `site_name` | `Team knowledge chat` |

Suggested questions:

- What does the documentation say about getting started?
- Which meetings are in the graph, and what were they about?

## Automation level bounds

The bundle sets no bound. Each automation pack's own limit applies.
